agreement_title: Out Growers Agreement for Seed Production - 26B
company_responsibilities:
1. Provide approved parent seed and agreed crop inputs.
  2. Provide technical supervision, field inspection coordination and harvest collection.
  3. Collect crib-ready seed within 30 days and pay accepted seed within 75 days.
farmer_responsibilities:
1. Maintain the contracted acreage, a minimum 200 metre isolation distance and the approved five-day planting lot.
  2. Follow the crop recipe, agronomy instructions and field inspection corrective actions.
  3. Deliver dry, traceable seed and protect company-supplied parent seed and inputs.
input_recovery_terms: Approved parent seed, stock inputs and supplier cash advances are recorded against the Crop Cycle and recovered transparently from the accepted harvest settlement.
legal_reference: Applicable Uganda seed law and National Seed Certification Service inspection and certification requirements.
name: 2026B Maize Basic Seed Growers Agreement
quality_terms: Initial payment uses net dry quantity normalized to 13% moisture, minimum 95% germination, genetic-purity/yield bands, an 8 mm screen rule and reject penalties. Potential genetic purity bonuses are deferred for QA approval and are due within 150 days. NSCS or approved laboratory evidence is required.
supervisor_responsibilities:
1. Verify plot, isolation, planting lot and stage records.
  2. Schedule and document agronomy activities and corrective actions.
  3. Maintain traceability through harvest, crib readiness, collection and delivery.
termination_terms: Company parent seed remains company property. Rejected or decertified acreage and produce are handled under the agreement and certification decision. Purity below 85% in two consecutive seasons triggers an eligibility review before a new contract.
